# Orders and control groups reference

The components that give orders to selected units and keep control groups, and the group and formation API. For how to use it, see [Orders and control groups](../modules/orders.md).

## VtUnitOrders

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Orders → VtUnitOrders**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

Lets players command a unit: move, attack-move, attack, hold position and stop. While it has no order the unit attacks hostile units that come inside its definition Aggro Range. Attached by `VtUnit` when the definition has `VtUnitDefinition.takesOrders` on; `VtOrderInput` gives the orders to the selected units.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scan Interval (`scanInterval`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds between scans for hostile units while idle, attack-moving or holding. |
| Arrival Distance (`arrivalDistance`) | `float` | 0.75 | ≥ 0.05 | Planar distance to the destination that counts as arrived when the unit is not moving. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtOrderScheduler Scheduler { get; }` | The order logic. Read its state here; give orders through `Issue`. |
| `VtOrderKind Kind { get; }` | The order being carried out. |
| `Vector3 OrderPoint { get; }` | The destination or held position of the current order. |
| `IVtAttackable OrderTarget { get; }` | The target of the current attack order, or null. |
| `event Action<VtOrderKind> OnOrderChanged` | Fires when an order is given or ends, with the order now held. Fires on the authority. |
| `void Initialize()` | Find the sibling components and set up the order logic. Runs on its own when needed; safe to call more than once. |
| `bool Issue(VtOrderKind kind, Vector3 point, IVtAttackable target = null)` | Give order `kind`: `point` is the destination of a move or attack-move, `target` the target of an attack. On the authority the order starts at once; on a predicting client it is sent to the authority. Returns false when it was refused or this copy of the unit cannot give orders. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance the order by `deltaTime` seconds. Authority only. |

## VtOrderInput

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Orders → VtOrderInput**. Adds [VtUnitSelection](selection.md#vtunitselection) automatically.

RTS orders for the units a `VtUnitSelection` holds. Command (right-click by default) on the ground moves the selected units there in formation, Command on a hostile unit or a resource node attacks it, the attack-move key followed by Confirm Target (left-click by default) attack-moves, and the stop and hold keys do what they say. Only selected units of the selecting side that have `VtUnitOrders` take orders; other selected units are only shown. Which units a command attacks is `VtFactionRules.CanAttackOnCommand`.

### Inspector fields

#### Raycasts

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ground Mask (`groundMask`) | `LayerMask` | Everything |  | Layers a move order can land on. |
| Unit Mask (`unitMask`) | `LayerMask` | Everything |  | Layers the unit colliders are on, for attack orders. |
| Ray Distance (`rayDistance`) | `float` | 500 | ≥ 1 | Max raycast distance, in world units. |

#### Input

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Command Action (`commandAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Moves or attacks at the pointer, and cancels a started attack-move. Empty uses Command from the Vantage input actions, the right mouse button by default. |
| Confirm Target Action (`confirmTargetAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Picks the attack-move point or target. Empty uses Confirm Target, the left mouse button by default. When it shares a button with Command, confirming wins. |
| Attack Move Action (`attackMoveAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Starts an attack-move; the next Confirm Target press picks the point or the target. Empty uses Attack Move from the Vantage input actions, A by default. |
| Stop Action (`stopAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Stops the selected units. Empty uses Stop, S by default. |
| Hold Action (`holdAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Makes the selected units hold their position. Empty uses Hold Position, H by default. |
| Cancel Action (`cancelAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Cancels a started attack-move. Command cancels too. Empty uses Cancel, Esc by default. |

#### Formation

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Formation Spacing (`formationSpacing`) | `float` | 1.6 | ≥ 0.1 | World units between formation slots. |

#### Feedback

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spawn Move Marker (`spawnMoveMarker`) | `bool` | On |  | Spawn a VtMoveMarker where a move or attack-move lands. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsTargetingAttackMove { get; }` | True while an attack-move waits for its Confirm Target press. |
| `bool BlocksPointerThisFrame { get; }` | True while an attack-move waits for its click and on the frame it ended, so that click does not also select. |
| `float FormationSpacing { get; set; }` | World units between formation slots. |
| `Func<Vector2, Ray> ScreenPointToRay { get; set; }` | Turns a screen position into the ray orders are raycast along. Null uses the main camera. |
| `event Action<VtOrderKind, int> OnOrderIssued` | Fires after an order went to the selected units, with the order and how many units took it. |
| `int GetCommandableUnits(List<VtUnit> results)` | Fill `results` with the selected units that take orders from this side: same faction as the selection viewer, alive, with an enabled `VtUnitOrders`. Returns the count. |
| `int OrderMove(Vector3 point)` | Move the selected units to `point` in formation. Returns how many took the order. |
| `int OrderAttackMove(Vector3 point)` | Attack-move the selected units to `point` in formation. Returns how many took the order. |
| `int OrderAttack(IVtAttackable target)` | Send the selected units at `target`. Returns how many took the order. |
| `int OrderStop()` | Stop the selected units. Returns how many took the order. |
| `int OrderHold()` | Make the selected units hold their position. Returns how many took the order. |
| `void BeginAttackMoveTargeting()` | Wait for a Confirm Target press that picks the attack-move point or target. Does nothing without commandable units. |
| `void CancelTargeting()` | Stop waiting for the attack-move click. |
| `int ConfirmAttackMove(Vector3 point, IVtAttackable hostile = null)` | Finish a started attack-move: attack `hostile` when given, otherwise attack-move to `point`. Returns how many units took the order, 0 when no attack-move was started. |

## VtControlGroups

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Selection → VtControlGroups**. Adds [VtUnitSelection](selection.md#vtunitselection) automatically.

Control groups on the number keys for the sibling `VtUnitSelection`. Ctrl and a group key saves the selection as that group, Shift and a group key adds the selection to it, and the key alone selects the living units of the group. Pressing it twice quickly also moves the camera to them.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Group Actions (`groupActions`) | `InputActionReference`[] | 10 entries |  | One action per group. With the Assign Modifier held it saves the selection, with the Additive Modifier it adds it, alone it selects the group. Empty entries use Control Group 1 to 10 from the Vantage input actions, keys 1 to 0 by default. |
| Assign Modifier Action (`assignModifierAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Held with a group action to save the selection as the group. Empty uses Assign Modifier, Ctrl by default. |
| Additive Modifier Action (`additiveModifierAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Held with a group action to add the selection to the group. Empty uses Additive Modifier, Shift by default. |
| Double Tap Seconds (`doubleTapSeconds`) | `float` | 0.35 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds between two presses of a group key that also move the camera to the group. |
| Focus Camera On Double Tap (`focusCameraOnDoubleTap`) | `bool` | On |  | Move the camera to a group when its key is pressed twice quickly. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtControlGroupSet Groups { get; }` | The groups. |
| `int GroupCount { get; }` | How many groups there are. |
| `Action<Vector3> FocusCamera { get; set; }` | Moves the camera to a point. Null uses `VtTopDownCamera.FocusOn` on the main camera. |
| `event Action<int, bool> OnGroupRecalled` | Fires after a group was selected, with its index and whether the camera moved to it. |
| `InputAction GetGroupAction(int group)` | The action that selects `group`, for key labels. Null past the last group. |
| `void AssignSelection(int group)` | Save the current selection as `group`. |
| `void AddSelection(int group)` | Add the current selection to `group`. |
| `bool Recall(int group, double time)` | Select the living units of `group`. A second call for the same group within the double-tap time also moves the camera to them. `time` is in seconds. Returns false for an empty group, which leaves the selection as it was. |
| `static Vector3 Centre(IReadOnlyList<VtUnit> units)` | The average position of `units`, ignoring destroyed ones. |

## VtControlGroupSet

Class.

Numbered groups of units a player saves and calls back, such as groups 1 to 0 on the number keys. A unit can be in several groups. Destroyed units drop out when a group is read. Pure C#.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `int GroupCount { get; }` | Number of groups. |
| `event Action<int> OnGroupChanged` | Fires after a group changed, with its index. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtUnit> Units(int group)` | The units in `group`, in the order they were added. Empty for an invalid index. |
| `bool Contains(int group, VtUnit unit)` | True when `unit` is in `group`. |
| `void Assign(int group, IEnumerable<VtUnit> units)` | Replace `group` with `units`, without nulls or duplicates. |
| `void Add(int group, IEnumerable<VtUnit> units)` | Add `units` to `group`, skipping units already in it. |
| `void Remove(VtUnit unit)` | Take `unit` out of every group. |
| `void Clear(int group)` | Empty `group`. |

## VtFormation

Static class.

Formation slots for group orders: a grid centred on the destination and turned to face the direction of travel, and a pass that sends each unit to a near free slot so paths cross less.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static void GridSlots(int count, Vector3 center, Vector3 facing, float spacing, List<Vector3> results)` | Fill `results` with `count` points in a grid centred on `center`, `spacing` apart. Rows run across `facing`, front row first. One unit gets the centre itself. |
| `static void AssignNearest(IReadOnlyList<Vector3> positions, IReadOnlyList<Vector3> slots, int[] assignment)` | Give every unit a slot. Slots are filled in order, each by the nearest unit without one. `assignment` receives the slot index per unit, or -1 when there were fewer slots. |

## Enums

### VtOrderKind

An order a unit with `VtUnitOrders` carries out.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Idle` | No order. The unit attacks hostile units that come inside its aggro range. |
| `Move` | Walk to a point and ignore enemies on the way. |
| `AttackMove` | Walk to a point and fight every hostile unit met on the way. |
| `Attack` | Attack one target until it dies. |
| `HoldPosition` | Stay in place and attack only what is within attack range. |
| `Stop` | Stop moving and fighting, then go idle. Given as an order, never held. |
